Name: Pridefroggos
Author: shalassa
Description:
[size=3]
[/size][list]
[left][*][size=3]Do you think the game needs more pride symbols?[/size]
[*][size=3]Do you think the game needs more frogs?[/size]
[*][size=3]Or do you just want a silly blob sitting on a tree sapling?[/size]
[/left][/list][size=3]

If the answer even one of these questions is "yes" then I have something for you! [b]Pridefroggos[/b], a replacer for all ten scarecrows. Available for CP and AT. It has options for the most common prideflags, as well as a several monochromatic frogs.


Available config options for now:

[b]Position[/b]: left, right
Decide whether you want the frog sitting on the left side, or the right

[b]Prideflag[/b]: green, trans, enby, ace, lesbian, gay, pan, bi, aro, polyam, poly, inter, fluid, queer, sapphic, achillean, purple, pink, blue, red
Pick the colour of the frog and the pot's trim.


I am open for suggestions for more prideflags and colours, as long as they are feasible.

Special thanks to the Stardew Valley discord, especially the mod-making channels for help and feedback


Other mods used in the screenshots:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿

[/size]
